mekanism:block_salt.excluded: Nine salt pack into a block, and salt is evaporated from water, which has no EMC.

mekanism:bounding_block.excluded: A multiblock places this structural block. It has no recipe and drops nothing.

mekanism:creative_bin.excluded: Creative-only bin. It has no survival recipe, and a value would only make a creative container transmutable.

mekanism:creative_chemical_tank.excluded: Creative-only chemical tank. It has no survival recipe.

mekanism:creative_energy_cube.excluded: Creative-only energy cube. It has no survival recipe.

mekanism:creative_fluid_tank.excluded: Creative-only fluid tank. It has no survival recipe.

mekanism:deepslate_fluorite_ore.excluded: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of fluorite gems. Only the gems are valued.

mekanism:deepslate_osmium_ore.excluded: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of raw osmium. Only the raw ore is valued.

mekanism:deepslate_uranium_ore.excluded: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of raw uranium. Only the raw ore is valued.

mekanism:dust_lithium.excluded: Lithium dust is crystallized from lithium, which a thermal evaporation plant makes from brine, which is water. Water has no EMC, so the dust does not either.

mekanism:fluorite_ore.excluded: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of fluorite gems. Only the gems are valued.

mekanism:nugget_osmium.excluded: An osmium ingot is fixed at 384 so osmium rails do not devalue vanilla rails, and nine nuggets cannot split 384 evenly.

mekanism:nugget_uranium.excluded: ProjectE fixes a uranium ingot at 4096, which nine nuggets cannot split evenly. Any nugget value lets one of the two crafting recipes gain EMC.

mekanism:osmium_ore.excluded: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of raw osmium. Only the raw ore is valued, as ProjectE does for ores.

mekanism:salt.excluded: A thermal evaporation plant makes brine from water, and crystallizing that brine makes salt. Water has no EMC, so salt does not either.

mekanism:uranium_ore.excluded: Drops a Fortune-boosted number of raw uranium. Only the raw ore is valued.

mekanismgenerators:bioethanol_bucket.excluded: Filled by a generator process (the bio generator, the separator, the solar neutron activator or the chemical infuser) and has no item recipe. Those processes are priced in later slices.
